deep.x: The goal is to let most AI use proceed quickly while focusing scrutiny where it matters. Good governance is measured by both safety and speed.
Pre-approved patterns

x: Approved tools with approved data classes: no review needed
Reference architectures with reviewed controls: delta review only
Low-risk categories (internal drafting, summarising): self-certify

deep.x: Measuring governance

items.b: median days from request to approval
share of AI systems in the inventory

deep.x: Continuous adjustment
Review which categories cause incidents and which never do. Loosen rules where risk proved low and tighten where problems appear.
If governance is too slow, people route around it, and you lose both speed and control.

quiz.q: Que doit consigner un inventaire de l'IA ?
options: Cas d'usage, responsable, données, modèle, niveau de risque et contrôles
quiz.explain: C'est la base de la gouvernance.

quiz.q: Depuis février 2025, l'AI Act de l'UE exige des déployeurs qu'ils veillent à…
options: Un niveau suffisant de maîtrise de l'IA chez les personnels qui l'utilisent
Utiliser uniquement des modèles open source
quiz.explain: L'obligation de maîtrise de l'IA.

quiz.q: Comment la gouvernance doit-elle traiter les cas d'usage à faible risque ?
options: Leur offrir une voie rapide avec des contrôles légers
Comme les cas à risque élevé
quiz.explain: Une gouvernance proportionnée.

lessons.title: IA responsable
lessons.summary: Des principes qui créent la confiance.

cards.title: Principes communs
cards.text: La plupart des référentiels d'IA responsable partagent des principes : équité, transparence, responsabilité, confidentialité, sûreté et fiabilité, et supervision humaine.

deep.x: Dozens of companies, governments and bodies have published responsible AI principles. The lists are remarkably similar, which makes them a useful common language.
Key sources
From principles to practice
Principles alone change nothing. They need to become concrete checks in design reviews, evaluation criteria and monitoring.
Example translation

x: Fairness → test error rates across groups before launch
Transparency → label AI-generated customer messages
Accountability → named owner in the AI inventory

deep.w: Responsible AI is a separate ethics project
deep.r: it works best embedded in normal product, risk and quality processes

cards.title: Équité
cards.text: Vérifiez que l'IA ne traite pas les personnes de façon inéquitable en fonction de caractéristiques protégées ou de variables qui y sont corrélées. Testez les résultats par groupe pour tout usage touchant des personnes.

deep.x: An AI system is unfair when it systematically disadvantages people based on protected characteristics such as sex, ethnicity, age or disability, or on proxies for them.
How bias enters
Real cases

x: Amazon scrapped an experimental CV-screening tool, reported in 2018, after it learned to penalise CVs mentioning "women's"
In the Netherlands, a benefits fraud system that used nationality as a risk factor contributed to the childcare benefits scandal; the government resigned in 2021

deep.x: Proxies
Removing the "gender" column isn't enough. Postcode, first name, career gaps or hobbies can stand in for protected attributes.
No single definition
Different fairness metrics (equal approval rates, equal error rates, equal accuracy) can mathematically conflict. Choosing one is a business and ethical decision, not only a technical one.
Test outcomes across groups; don't assume fairness because sensitive data was excluded.

cards.title: Transparence

items: Fiches de modèle et de système

cards.text: Les personnes doivent savoir quand l'IA intervient et, pour les décisions importantes, comprendre les principales raisons. En interne, documentez le fonctionnement des systèmes et leurs limites.

deep.x: Transparency has two audiences: people affected by AI, who should know it's involved and why it decided as it did, and internal reviewers, who need to understand how the system works.

items: Explanation: main reasons for a decision
Documentation: how it works and its limits

deep.x: Legal duties

items.b: people must be told when interacting with a chatbot
deepfakes and certain synthetic content must be labelled
meaningful information about the logic of automated decisions

deep.x: Explanations that help
A good explanation names the main factors and what the person could change: "the application was declined mainly due to short credit history and high existing debt".

x: Avoid technical jargon
Focus on actionable factors
Offer a route to human review

deep.x: Internal transparency
Document data sources, intended use, known limits and evaluation results, so reviewers, auditors and future maintainers can understand the system.
Research shows people trust AI recommendations more appropriately, neither too much nor too little, when they understand its typical error patterns.

cards.title: Responsabilité
cards.text: Une personne ou une équipe désignée est responsable des résultats de chaque système d'IA. « L'algorithme a décidé » n'est jamais une réponse acceptable.

deep.x: Accountability means a specific person or team answers for each AI system's behaviour and outcomes. AI can make decisions, but it can't be responsible for them.

items.r: "The credit team owns this model and its decisions"

deep.x: Who is accountable
Mechanisms

x: Named owner in the AI inventory
Sign-off before launch and after major changes
Audit trails of decisions and changes
Clear escalation paths when something goes wrong

deep.x: Courts agree
The Air Canada chatbot case (2024) and many regulatory decisions confirm that organisations are responsible for their AI systems' outputs.
Every AI system needs a human name next to it.

cards.title: Supervision humaine
cards.text: Décidez où les humains doivent intervenir : avant l'action (human-in-the-loop), en surveillance avec capacité d'intervention (human-on-the-loop) ou lors d'audits périodiques.

deep.x: Human oversight means people can understand, monitor and intervene in AI systems. The right level depends on the stakes.
Choosing the level
Automation bias
People tend to over-trust automated recommendations, especially when tired or busy. A human who clicks "approve" on everything provides no real oversight.

x: Show confidence and the evidence behind each recommendation
Track how often reviewers disagree; zero disagreement is a warning sign
Give reviewers time and authority to override
Occasionally insert test cases to check attention

deep.x: Legal requirement
The EU AI Act requires high-risk systems to be designed for effective human oversight, and deployers to assign it to people with competence, training and authority.

deep.w: A human in the loop makes it safe
deep.r: only if the human has time, information and power to disagree

cards.title: Fiabilité

steps: Passer la main à un humain

cards.text: Les systèmes d'IA doivent fonctionner de façon constante dans leur périmètre prévu, avec des limites testées et une gestion maîtrisée de l'incertitude : passer la main plutôt que deviner.

deep.x: A reliable AI system performs consistently within its intended scope, knows its limits and fails safely when it meets something outside them.
Scope matters
An invoice extractor tested on Portuguese and Spanish suppliers may fail on Chinese invoices. Document the tested scope and detect inputs outside it.
Graceful failure

x: Confidence thresholds below which outputs go to review
"I don't know" answers when sources don't contain the answer
Fallback to rules or humans when the AI service is down

deep.x: Robustness tests
Reliability is knowing when not to answer.

cards.title: Impact sur les personnels
cards.text: Une adoption responsable pense aux personnes : communiquer ouvertement, impliquer les employés, investir dans la reconversion et repenser les rôles avec soin.

deep.x: AI changes jobs. How it's introduced, openly or secretly, with or without people, shapes both adoption and trust.
What usually changes

items.b: AI operations, prompt and evaluation specialists

deep.x: Good practices

x: Be honest about goals, including efficiency targets
Involve experienced staff in designing workflows: they know the edge cases
Fund reskilling before roles change, not after
Consult works councils or worker representatives where required

deep.x: Legal angle
The EU AI Act requires employers to inform workers' representatives and affected workers before putting high-risk AI systems into use at the workplace.
Studies of early generative AI deployments often found the largest gains among less experienced workers, narrowing the gap with top performers.

cards.title: Impact environnemental
cards.text: L'IA consomme de l'énergie et de l'eau. Choisissez des modèles efficaces, évitez l'usage inutile des plus grands modèles et privilégiez les régions cloud alimentées par une énergie propre.

deep.x: AI runs in data centres that consume electricity and water. The footprint per query is small, but scale makes the total significant.
Per query

Google reported in 2025 that a median text prompt to its Gemini assistant used about 0.24 Wh of electricity, roughly nine seconds of TV, and about 0.26 mL of water. Large reasoning tasks, images and video use much more.
Practical levers
Training vs use

x: Report AI energy in sustainability disclosures where material (CSRD in the EU)
Ask vendors for energy and emissions data per use

deep.x: The biggest efficiency win is usually choosing the right-sized model for each task.

cards.title: Fiches de modèle et de système
cards.text: De courts documents décrivant la finalité, les données, les performances, les limites et l'usage prévu d'un système aident utilisateurs et évaluateurs à le comprendre.

deep.x: Model cards and system cards are short documents describing what an AI system is for, how it was built, how well it performs and where it shouldn't be used.
Origins

The "model cards" idea was proposed by Google researchers (Mitchell et al.) in 2019, alongside "datasheets for datasets" (Gebru et al., 2018). Major AI labs now publish system cards for frontier models.
For internal systems
A one-to-two-page card per AI application helps:

x: Users understand what to trust it with
Reviewers check risks quickly
Auditors and regulators see evidence
Future teams maintain it safely

deep.x: Performance by segment
Segment results reveal where human review is still needed.
Under the EU AI Act, providers of high-risk systems must supply technical documentation and instructions for use: a formal version of the same idea.

cards.title: L'objectif : la confiance
cards.text: L'IA responsable n'est pas un frein ; elle construit la confiance qui permet aux clients, aux régulateurs et aux employés d'accepter l'IA à grande échelle.

deep.x: Responsible AI isn't a brake on innovation. It builds the trust that customers, employees and regulators need before they accept AI in decisions that matter.
Trust is asymmetric
One public failure, a discriminatory model or a leaking chatbot, can undo years of progress and trigger regulatory attention.
Signals of trustworthy AI

x: Clear disclosure and easy route to a human
Consistent, verifiable answers with sources
Quick correction of mistakes
Independent certification (e.g. ISO/IEC 42001)

deep.x: Competitive advantage
Speed comes from trust: the more people trust your AI, the more you can do with it.

quiz.q: Quelle explication est acceptable pour une décision assistée par l'IA ?
options: « L'équipe a décidé en s'appuyant sur une recommandation de l'IA »
quiz.explain: Un humain ou une équipe reste responsable.

quiz.q: Human-on-the-loop signifie…
options: Des humains surveillent et peuvent intervenir
quiz.explain: Une surveillance avec capacité d'intervention.

quiz.q: Que doit faire un système d'IA en cas d'incertitude ?
options: Passer la main à un humain
quiz.explain: Une gestion maîtrisée de l'incertitude.

lessons.title: MLOps et LLMOps
lessons.summary: Exploiter l'IA de façon fiable en production.

cards.title: Des modèles vivants
cards.text: Contrairement aux logiciels classiques, le comportement de l'IA dépend de données et de modèles qui évoluent. L'IA en production exige surveillance, réentraînement et évaluation continus.

deep.x: Traditional software behaves the same until someone changes the code. AI systems change behaviour when data, models or the world change, even if nobody touches the code.
Things that change underneath you
Hidden technical debt
A famous 2015 Google paper, "Hidden Technical Debt in Machine Learning Systems", showed that the model code is a small part of a real ML system; data pipelines, configuration and monitoring dominate.

v.unit: share of a production ML system (illustrative)

deep.x: Ownership after launch

x: Budget for ongoing operation, not only the build
Name an owner responsible for performance
Schedule periodic reviews even when nothing seems wrong

deep.x: Launch is the start of an AI system's life, not the end of the project.

cards.title: MLOps
cards.text: Le MLOps applique les pratiques DevOps à l'apprentissage automatique : versionner données et modèles, automatiser les pipelines d'entraînement, tester avant le déploiement et surveiller en production.

deep.x: MLOps applies DevOps practices to machine learning: automation, versioning, testing and monitoring, so models move from notebook to production reliably and repeatably.
Core components

items.b: consistent inputs for training and serving

deep.x: Maturity levels
Why it matters

x: Reproducibility: rebuild any past model exactly
Auditability: show which data trained which model
Speed: retrain and redeploy in hours rather than weeks

deep.x: Typical tools include MLflow, Kubeflow, cloud ML platforms and data versioning tools; the practices matter more than the brand.

cards.title: LLMOps
cards.text: Pour l'IA générative, les éléments mouvants sont les prompts, les index de recherche, les outils, les garde-fous et les versions de modèles. Tous doivent être versionnés, testés et surveillés.

deep.x: LLMOps adapts MLOps to generative AI. You often don't train models, but you have many other moving parts that change behaviour.
Differences from classic MLOps
Version everything
Store prompts in version control, not in a database field someone edits by hand. Each release bundles prompt, model version, retrieval config and tools.
Typical pipeline
Vendor model updates
Providers update and retire models. Pin specific versions, monitor deprecation notices and re-run evaluations before switching.
Treat a prompt like code: versioned, reviewed, tested and released.

cards.title: Étapes d'évaluation

steps: Livrer seulement si égal ou meilleur

cards.text: Chaque changement (nouveau prompt, nouveau modèle, nouvelles données) passe par des évaluations automatisées avant sa publication. Si la qualité baisse, le changement n'est pas livré.

deep.x: An evaluation gate is an automated quality check every change must pass before release. It's the AI equivalent of a test suite.
What's in an eval set
Scoring methods
Thresholds
Define acceptable minimums and acceptable change: for example, accuracy at least 95% and no category dropping more than two points.

x: Safety tests should be zero-tolerance
Cost and latency can have budgets too
Track scores over time to spot slow decline

deep.w: A change that improves average quality is safe to ship
deep.r: it may fix common cases while breaking a rare but critical one

cards.title: Surveiller la qualité
cards.text: Suivez des indicateurs indirects de précision (retours des utilisateurs, taux de corrections, taux d'escalade), la dérive des entrées, la latence, les erreurs et le coût. Échantillonnez des sorties pour une revue humaine.

deep.x: In production you rarely have the correct answer for every output, so you monitor proxies that reveal quality problems early.
Proxy signals
Human sampling
Regularly sample outputs, say 50 per week, for expert review. It catches subtle problems such as tone drift or plausible but wrong answers that proxies miss.
Alerts

x: Thresholds on error and escalation rates
Sudden shifts in input types or lengths
Spend spikes per application

deep.x: Monitor what users do with outputs, not just whether the system is up.

cards.title: Dérive des données
cards.text: Quand les données entrantes changent (nouveaux produits, nouveaux formats de documents, nouveaux marchés), les performances du modèle peuvent se dégrader sans bruit. La détection de dérive alerte l'équipe.

deep.x: Data drift happens when real-world inputs differ from what the model was built and tested on. Performance can degrade silently because nothing technically breaks.
Types of drift

items.b: a source system changes a field's meaning

deep.x: Famous example
In 2020, the COVID-19 pandemic broke many demand forecasting and fraud models overnight because buying behaviour changed radically.
Detection

x: Compare input distributions against training data
Watch prediction distributions for shifts
Track accuracy where true outcomes arrive later

deep.x: In 2021 Zillow closed its home-buying business after its pricing models failed to keep up with a rapidly changing housing market, at a cost of hundreds of millions of dollars.

cards.title: Retours arrière

steps: Feature flag coupé ou retour arrière

cards.text: Gardez la version précédente prête. Si une version pose problème, revenez vite en arrière. Les feature flags permettent de désactiver des fonctions d'IA sans redéployer.

deep.x: Things will go wrong after a release. The ability to return quickly to the last good version turns a potential crisis into a minor incident.

steps: Flip feature flag or roll back

deep.x: Make rollback easy

x: Keep the previous prompt, model and index versions deployable
Use feature flags to switch AI features off instantly
Canary releases: give the new version to 5% of users first
Automate rollback when error metrics cross thresholds

deep.x: Release strategies

items.b: new version runs silently alongside the old
switch all traffic between two environments

deep.x: Data considerations
Rolling back a model is easy; rolling back actions an agent took is not. Agents with write access need extra caution and staged rollouts.
If you can't roll back in minutes, you're not ready to release.

cards.title: Suivi des coûts

items: Dépenses par appli et par équipe

cards.text: Les coûts de l'IA générative évoluent avec l'usage. Suivez les dépenses par application et par équipe, fixez des budgets et des alertes, et optimisez les prompts et le choix du modèle.

deep.x: Generative AI cost scales with usage, tokens and model choice. Without monitoring, a successful pilot can turn into a budget surprise.

items.b: large models cost far more per token

deep.x: Typical savings levers

items: Route easy tasks to small models

deep.x: Showback and chargeback
Attribute spend to teams and applications via the gateway. Showing teams their own spend changes behaviour quickly.
Unit economics
Track cost per task, not just total spend: euros per invoice processed, per ticket resolved, per contract reviewed. Compare with the human cost of the same task.

x: 10,000 invoices per month
× €0.02 AI cost each
= €200 vs hours of manual entry

deep.x: Per-token prices for a given capability level have fallen dramatically year after year, but usage typically grows even faster.

cards.title: Boucles de retour humain
cards.text: Les corrections apportées par les utilisateurs sont de précieuses données d'entraînement et d'évaluation. Collectez-les systématiquement pour améliorer les prompts, la recherche et les modèles.

deep.x: Every time a user corrects an AI output, they create valuable data. Capturing it systematically turns daily work into continuous improvement.
Ways to capture feedback
Using it

x: Add frequent failure cases to the evaluation set
Fix retrieval gaps where answers were missing
Adjust prompts for recurring style issues
Use corrections as fine-tuning or few-shot examples where appropriate

deep.x: Make feedback cheap
Close the loop
Tell users what changed because of their feedback. People keep giving feedback when they see it matter.
The best training data you'll ever have is your own experts correcting your own system.

cards.title: Équipes plateforme
cards.text: Une équipe plateforme centrale fournit généralement l'outillage (pipelines, passerelle, supervision, cadres d'évaluation) pour que les équipes produit se concentrent sur les cas d'usage.

deep.x: A central AI platform team builds shared tooling so product teams can focus on solving business problems instead of rebuilding infrastructure.
Hub and spoke
What makes platforms succeed

x: Treat internal teams as customers, with documentation and support
Make the paved road easier than going alone
Measure adoption and time-to-launch
Avoid becoming a bottleneck that must build every use case

deep.x: Evolution

events.l: centre focuses on standards and hard problems

deep.x: A good platform team makes the right way the easy way.

quiz.q: Que doit-il se passer avant la publication d'une nouvelle version de prompt ?
options: Elle doit réussir des évaluations automatisées
Elle nécessite un communiqué de presse
quiz.explain: Les étapes d'évaluation évitent les régressions.

quiz.q: Qu'est-ce que la dérive des données (data drift) ?
options: Des données entrantes qui changent et dégradent les performances du modèle
quiz.explain: Surveiller et réentraîner.

quiz.q: Qu'est-ce qui permet de désactiver une fonction d'IA sans redéploiement ?
quiz.explain: Les feature flags offrent un contrôle rapide.

lessons.title: Du pilote à la production
lessons.summary: Sortir du purgatoire des pilotes.

cards.title: Le purgatoire des pilotes
cards.text: De nombreuses organisations mènent des dizaines de pilotes d'IA qui impressionnent en démo mais ne passent jamais à l'échelle. Causes courantes : pas de responsable clair, pas de plan d'intégration, valeur non démontrée et questions de risque non résolues.

deep.x: "Pilot purgatory" describes organisations with dozens of promising AI experiments and almost nothing running at scale. Demos impress; production doesn't follow.
The numbers

Gartner predicted in 2024 that at least 30% of generative AI projects would be abandoned after proof of concept by the end of 2025, citing poor data quality, inadequate risk controls, escalating costs or unclear business value.
Why demos mislead
Escaping purgatory

x: Fewer pilots, chosen for value and feasibility
Each pilot has a sponsor committed to scale if it works
Production requirements (security, integration) addressed from week one
Clear go/no-go decision at the end

deep.x: A pilot without a path to production is a demo with a budget.

cards.title: Concevoir pour la production dès le premier jour
cards.text: Même dans un pilote, utilisez de vraies données, de vrais utilisateurs, l'architecture cible et les contrôles de sécurité. Une démo sur des échantillons propres ne prouve pas grand-chose.

deep.x: A pilot should test whether the solution works in reality, not whether AI can work in principle. That means real data, real users and the target architecture.
What to include early

x: Real documents, with their scans, typos and odd formats
Actual users doing real work, not only enthusiasts
Security and privacy review of the data used
The gateway, logging and evaluation you'll use later

deep.x: What can wait

items.b: start with the top document types

deep.x: The rebuild trap
Pilots built on shortcuts often need a complete rebuild for production, which costs months and kills momentum.
Good pilots answer three questions at once: does it work, will people use it, and can we run it safely?

cards.title: Définir le succès dès le départ
cards.text: Convenez de critères de succès mesurables avant de commencer : seuil de précision, temps économisé, satisfaction des utilisateurs, coût par transaction.

deep.x: Agreeing success criteria before starting prevents moving goalposts and endless "promising" pilots. It also forces clarity on what the solution is actually for.
Example criteria

items.b: 95% of fields correct, 50% less handling time
all key clauses found, review time halved

deep.x: Measure the baseline
You can't claim time savings without knowing today's time. Measure the current process for a few weeks before the pilot.
Decision rules
Write down what happens at the end: if targets are met, scale with budget X; if close, one more iteration; if far off, stop.
Decide how you'll judge success before you fall in love with the solution.

cards.title: L'intégration, c'est le vrai travail
cards.text: La valeur apparaît quand l'IA est dans le flux de travail : dans l'écran de l'ERP, le client de messagerie, l'outil de tickets, et non dans une fenêtre de chat distincte que l'on oublie d'utiliser.

deep.x: AI creates value only when it's inside the workflow people already use. A separate chat window competes with habit and usually loses.
Examples of embedding

x: Extracted invoice fields appear pre-filled in the ERP screen
Suggested replies appear inside the ticketing tool
Contract risks are flagged within the document management system
Meeting summaries land automatically in the CRM record

deep.x: Where effort goes

v.unit: typical effort in an AI rollout, % (illustrative)

deep.x: Integration patterns

deep.w: The model is the hard part
deep.r: in most corporate projects, integration, data and adoption take far more effort than the AI itself

cards.title: Gérer les exceptions
cards.text: Concevez pour les cas que l'IA ne sait pas traiter : une faible confiance renvoie vers des humains, avec un moyen simple de corriger et d'apprendre.

deep.x: Every AI system meets cases it can't handle well. Designing a good path for them is what makes automation safe and trustworthy.
Sources of exceptions
Designing the human queue

x: Show the AI's proposal, its confidence and the reason it was flagged
Highlight the uncertain fields rather than the whole document
Make correcting faster than doing it from scratch
Track exception rates by type to target improvements

deep.x: The automation curve
Typically, a few common case types make up most volume. Automate those well and route the long tail to people.
Aim for excellent handling of the common 80% and graceful routing of the rest.

cards.title: Passer à l'échelle pas à pas
cards.text: Étendez progressivement : une équipe, une région, un type de document, puis davantage. Chaque étape révèle de nouveaux cas limites et renforce la confiance.

deep.x: Rolling out gradually reveals new problems while they're still small and builds evidence and trust for the next step.
What each step reveals

x: New languages, formats and local rules
Different working habits and system configurations
Load and cost at higher volume
Support needs and training gaps

deep.x: Gate between steps
Speed vs safety
Staged rollouts also create internal reference teams: early users can demonstrate and support the next group.

cards.title: Responsabilité d'exploitation
cards.text: Après le lancement, quelqu'un doit en être responsable : supervision, support, améliorations et coûts. Sans responsable, les solutions se dégradent.

deep.x: Once live, an AI solution needs an owner just like any critical system. Without one, quality decays, costs drift and users lose trust.
Business and technical owners
Run budget
Plan the yearly run cost from the start: model usage, infrastructure, support, monitoring and periodic re-evaluation. A solution with no run budget will be switched off or neglected.
Decay signals

x: Rising exception or correction rates
Users drifting back to manual methods
Unanswered support requests
Nobody knows who to ask

deep.x: A launch without an owner is the start of a slow failure.

cards.title: Industrialiser le schéma
cards.text: Une fois qu'un cas d'usage fonctionne, transformez-le en schéma réutilisable (extraction de documents, assistant de connaissances, tri) et appliquez-le à des processus similaires.

deep.x: Many business problems share the same shape. Once one works, turning it into a reusable pattern makes the next ones much faster and cheaper.
From project to product
What gets reused

x: Connectors and integrations
Prompts and evaluation sets for the pattern
User interface components
Security and privacy assessments

deep.x: The economics
Companies that scale AI well often think in terms of a "factory" of patterns rather than a collection of separate projects.

cards.title: Faire connaître les succès
cards.text: Partagez en interne les résultats mesurés : heures économisées, erreurs évitées, témoignages d'utilisateurs. Des succès visibles créent une dynamique et du financement pour la vague suivante.

deep.x: Visible, measured successes build momentum, attract business sponsors and secure funding for the next wave. Silence lets scepticism win.
Make results concrete

items.r: "Invoice handling fell from 9 to 3 minutes, 4,000 hours freed per year"

deep.x: Channels

x: Short internal posts with a number and a story
Live demos at town halls and team meetings
Testimonials from users, not just the project team
Dashboards showing adoption and impact

deep.x: Be honest
Share what didn't work too. Credible communication, including limits and failures, builds more trust than hype.
One measured story from a respected colleague beats ten slide decks.

cards.title: Arrêter ce qui ne marche pas

steps: Évaluer le pilote selon les critères

cards.text: Tous les pilotes ne doivent pas passer à l'échelle. Une décision d'arrêt rigoureuse libère des ressources et témoigne d'un portefeuille sain.

deep.x: Stopping a pilot that isn't delivering is a success of the process, not a failure. It frees people and budget for better opportunities.
Reasons to stop
Avoid zombie projects
Learn from stops

x: Document what was tried and why it failed
Keep reusable components and data work
Revisit later: newer models may solve what earlier ones couldn't

deep.x: Some failed pilots become viable a year later simply because model quality improved or costs fell.

quiz.q: Qu'est-ce que le « purgatoire des pilotes » ?
options: De nombreux pilotes qui n'arrivent jamais en production
quiz.explain: Les pilotes s'enlisent sans responsables, sans intégration et sans preuve de valeur.

quiz.q: Où un outil d'IA doit-il se trouver pour être massivement adopté ?
options: Dans les outils de travail que les gens utilisent déjà
quiz.explain: Les outils intégrés sont utilisés.

quiz.q: Que faire des résultats d'IA à faible confiance ?
quiz.explain: Les exceptions vont aux personnes.

lessons.title: Conduite du changement et adoption
lessons.summary: Aider les gens à utiliser réellement l'IA.

cards.title: La technologie est la partie facile
cards.text: Les projets d'IA échouent plus souvent parce que les gens ne les adoptent pas que parce que la technologie défaille. La conduite du changement mérite un vrai budget et une vraie attention.

deep.x: AI projects fail more often because people don't use them than because the technology doesn't work. Change management is not a side task; it decides the outcome.
Why people resist

x: Fear of job loss or reduced status
Distrust of AI accuracy
Habit and time pressure: the old way feels faster
Unclear benefit for them personally

deep.x: The 10-20-70 rule
Boston Consulting Group's rule of thumb: about 10% of the effort in AI transformation is algorithms, 20% technology and data, and 70% people and processes.

v.unit: where AI effort should go, % (BCG's 10-20-70 rule)

deep.x: What change management covers
Budget for people as seriously as for technology.

cards.title: Aborder les craintes ouvertement
cards.text: Les gens s'inquiètent pour leur emploi, d'être surveillés et de paraître incompétents. Les dirigeants doivent expliquer honnêtement l'objectif et l'évolution des rôles.

deep.x: People worry about job security, surveillance and looking incompetent with new tools. Ignoring these fears doesn't make them go away; it makes rumours fill the gap.
Honest communication

x: Explain the purpose: growth, quality, workload or cost, and be truthful
Describe how roles will change, not just that they will
Commit to reskilling and say how
Clarify what data is and isn't collected about employees

deep.x: Avoid

items.r: "Your tasks will shift, here's how we'll support you"

deep.x: Psychological safety
People need to experiment and make mistakes with AI without judgement. Leaders sharing their own early fumbles helps.
Under the EU AI Act, emotion recognition systems are banned in the workplace (except for medical or safety reasons), which addresses one common fear directly.

cards.title: Réseau de champions
cards.text: Des utilisateurs précoces enthousiastes dans chaque équipe aident leurs collègues, partagent des astuces et font des retours. L'apprentissage entre pairs se diffuse plus vite que la formation centrale.

deep.x: Champions are enthusiastic early users in each team who help colleagues, share tips and relay feedback. They spread adoption faster than any central programme.
Why it works
Supporting champions

x: Dedicated time, even a few hours per month
A community channel to share prompts and tricks
Early access to new features
Recognition from leadership

deep.x: What they do
People learn new tools best from colleagues doing the same job.

cards.title: Formation pratique
cards.text: De courtes séances pratiques sur des tâches réelles du travail des participants valent mieux que des présentations génériques. Montrez des exemples avant/après.

deep.x: Practical sessions using people's real tasks change behaviour; generic slide presentations rarely do.
A good session

steps: Show a real task done the old way

deep.x: Content that sticks

x: Before-and-after examples from the team's own work
How to check outputs and spot errors
What data is allowed in which tool
A small set of prompts to start with

deep.x: Formats
Short, repeated sessions spaced over weeks lead to better retention than one long training day, a well-known effect in learning research called spacing.

cards.title: Repenser le processus
cards.text: Plaquer l'IA sur un processus inchangé donne de petits gains. Repenser les étapes, les rôles et les validations autour de l'IA en débloque de bien plus grands.

deep.x: Adding AI to an unchanged process delivers small gains. Rethinking the process around what AI does well unlocks much larger ones.
Example: supplier invoices
Questions to ask

x: Which steps exist only because information was hard to find or type?
Which approvals could become rule-based checks?
Who should handle exceptions, and with what tools?
What new controls are needed?

deep.x: History repeats
When factories electrified around 1900, productivity gains came only decades later, once factory layouts were redesigned around electric motors instead of a central steam shaft.
Don't automate the old process; design the new one.

cards.title: Les dirigeants montrent l'exemple
cards.text: Quand les dirigeants utilisent eux-mêmes les outils d'IA de façon visible et en parlent, l'adoption augmente. Sinon, les équipes en concluent que ce n'est pas important.

deep.x: Teams watch what leaders do more than what they say. When leaders use AI visibly, adoption rises; when they don't, people conclude it doesn't matter.
Visible behaviours

x: Mention AI use in meetings ("I drafted this with the assistant, then edited it")
Share a favourite prompt or use case
Ask teams what they've tried
Admit what didn't work

deep.x: Leadership traps

items: "use AI" but no time to learn

deep.x: Executive training
Senior leaders often get the least hands-on training. Short, private sessions with their own tasks help them become credible advocates.
Surveys repeatedly find that employees whose managers actively support AI use are far more likely to use it regularly.

cards.title: Mesurer l'adoption
cards.text: Suivez les utilisateurs actifs, la fréquence, les cas d'usage, la satisfaction et l'impact. Une faible adoption dans une équipe est un signal pour enquêter, pas seulement pour pousser plus fort.

deep.x: Adoption metrics show whether the tool is part of daily work, and where to intervene. Licences bought don't equal value delivered.
Funnel view
Reading the signals
Qualitative input
Combine numbers with interviews and surveys. Ask what people use it for, what frustrates them and what they wish it could do.
Low adoption is a signal to listen, not a reason to mandate.

cards.title: Faciliter l'usage

items: Bibliothèque de prompts et de modèles

cards.text: L'authentification unique, l'intégration aux outils existants, les bibliothèques de prompts et les modèles suppriment les frictions. Chaque clic en plus coûte de l'adoption.

deep.x: Every extra click, login or copy-paste step reduces adoption. Removing friction is one of the most effective change levers.
Friction examples

items.r: Assistant inside email and Office with one click

deep.x: Prompt libraries and templates
Curated, tested prompts for common tasks ("summarise this contract's payment terms") let people get value immediately without learning prompting from scratch.
Defaults matter

x: Turn on AI features where safe rather than requiring opt-in
Pre-configure assistants with company context
Make the approved tool the easiest option

deep.x: Behavioural science shows defaults strongly shape choices: people tend to stick with whatever is pre-selected.

cards.title: Célébrer et partager
cards.text: Partagez des histoires de réussite, organisez des démonstrations internes ou des hackathons, et reconnaissez ceux qui trouvent de nouveaux usages utiles.

deep.x: Recognition and shared stories keep momentum going after the launch excitement fades, and spread good ideas across the organisation.
Hackathons
Short events where business and tech staff build AI prototypes together generate ideas, skills and enthusiasm, and surface use cases nobody had prioritised.
Use-case gallery
A searchable internal catalogue of real uses, with prompts and results, lets others copy what works.
Recognise the right things
Make it easy to copy success.

cards.title: ADKAR en bref
cards.text: Un modèle de changement courant : Awareness (comprendre pourquoi), Desire (vouloir participer), Knowledge (savoir comment), Ability (être capable de le faire), Reinforcement (renforcer pour que cela dure).

deep.x: ADKAR is a widely used change management model developed by Jeff Hiatt of Prosci. It describes five outcomes individuals need for a change to succeed.

items: Ability: able to do it in practice

deep.x: Applied to AI adoption

items.b: why AI, what changes, what doesn't

deep.x: Diagnosing barriers
Find the first element that's missing. Training (Knowledge) won't help someone who doesn't see why (Awareness) or doesn't want to (Desire).
Other models

x: Kotter's 8 steps: urgency, coalition, vision, communication, empowerment, quick wins, build on change, anchor in culture
Lewin's unfreeze, change, refreeze

deep.x: Fix the earliest missing step first.

quiz.q: Pourquoi de nombreux outils d'IA sont-ils peu utilisés ?
options: Les gens ne sont pas accompagnés pour changer leur façon de travailler
quiz.explain: L'adoption exige une conduite du changement.

quiz.q: Qu'est-ce qu'un réseau de champions de l'IA ?
options: Des adoptants précoces qui aident et forment leurs collègues
quiz.explain: L'entraide entre pairs diffuse l'adoption.

quiz.q: Que signifie le « A » au début d'ADKAR ?
quiz.explain: La prise de conscience de la nécessité du changement.

lessons.title: Compétences et modèle opérationnel
lessons.summary: Qui fait quoi dans une entreprise dotée d'IA.

cards.title: La maîtrise de l'IA pour tous

items: Ce que l'IA peut et ne peut pas faire
Règles de données et de confidentialité

cards.text: Toute personne qui utilise l'IA a besoin de bases : ce qu'elle peut et ne peut pas faire, comment écrire un prompt, comment vérifier les sorties et quelles règles de données s'appliquent. L'AI Act de l'UE l'exige désormais.

deep.x: Basic AI literacy is now a baseline skill, like using email or spreadsheets. In the EU it's also a legal requirement for organisations using AI.

items: What AI can and can't do

deep.x: Core concepts everyone should know

x: AI generates plausible text, which can be wrong (hallucinations)
Outputs need checking in proportion to the stakes
Some data must never go into some tools
AI can reflect bias in its training data

deep.x: Levels
Legal duty
Since February 2025, the EU AI Act requires providers and deployers to ensure sufficient AI literacy among staff using AI systems.
Literacy is the foundation; without it, tools are misused or ignored.

cards.title: Rôles clés
cards.text: Construire de l'IA demande un mélange : product owners, data engineers, ingénieurs ML/IA, ingénieurs logiciels, designers et experts métier, plus des rôles de gouvernance.

deep.x: Building AI solutions needs a team with mixed skills. Missing any one of them is a common cause of failure.
Plus governance roles
Typical small team
A typical first squad: a product owner, two engineers (one AI-focused), part of a data engineer, a designer for a few weeks, and a domain expert with real time allocated.
Common gaps

x: No real product owner: the project drifts
Domain experts "available when needed": they aren't
No one owns data quality

deep.x: The "AI engineer" role, building with models via APIs rather than training them, grew rapidly with generative AI and overlaps heavily with software engineering.

cards.title: Centre d'excellence
cards.text: Un centre d'excellence IA central fixe les standards, construit la plateforme, partage les bonnes pratiques et aide les équipes. Il évite les doublons et les contrôles incohérents.

deep.x: An AI Centre of Excellence (CoE) is a central team that sets standards, builds shared platforms and helps the rest of the company use AI well.
Benefits
Risks

x: Becoming an ivory tower disconnected from the business
Becoming a bottleneck that must approve or build everything
Focusing on cool technology over business value

deep.x: Evolution
A CoE succeeds when business teams can deliver without it.

cards.title: Hub and spoke
cards.text: Un modèle courant : un hub central (plateforme, gouvernance, expertise) et des « spokes » intégrés dans les unités métier, qui connaissent les processus locaux et portent les cas d'usage.

deep.x: The hub-and-spoke model combines a central hub with AI people embedded in business units, balancing consistency with local knowledge.
Division of work
Why it's popular
Purely central teams lack business context; purely decentralised teams duplicate effort and controls. Hub and spoke gets most of both benefits.
Making it work

x: Dotted-line reporting from spokes to the hub
Common tools and templates
Regular community meetings
Shared portfolio view of all use cases

deep.x: Many large companies move from centralised, to hub-and-spoke, to largely federated as AI maturity grows.

cards.title: Équipes mondiales
cards.text: Les grandes entreprises combinent souvent des équipes plateforme mondiales et des pôles de livraison régionaux, pour concilier standards, besoins locaux et fuseaux horaires.

deep.x: Large companies combine global platform teams with regional delivery hubs to balance common standards with local needs, languages and time zones.
Typical setup

items: Business spokes: per unit and country

deep.x: Shared service centres

Many companies run finance, procurement and IT service centres in places such as Portugal, Poland, India or the Philippines. These centres are natural homes for AI delivery, since they hold process knowledge and volume.
Challenges

x: Different data protection rules by country
Local systems and process variants
Coordination across time zones
Ensuring knowledge flows both ways

deep.x: Standardise the platform globally; adapt the solution locally.

cards.title: Faire monter en compétences les ingénieurs
cards.text: Les développeurs en place peuvent apprendre rapidement l'ingénierie de l'IA : API, RAG, évaluation, conception de prompts. Monter en compétences et recruter quelques spécialistes vaut souvent mieux que de n'embaucher que de nouveaux experts.

deep.x: Existing software and data engineers can learn AI engineering quickly. Combining upskilling with a few specialists usually beats hiring only external experts.
Why upskill
Learning path

x: Week 1–2: call models via API, prompt design, structured outputs
Week 3–6: build a RAG application and an agent with tools
Ongoing: evaluation methods, security, cost optimisation

deep.x: Learning by doing
Pair learners with experienced AI engineers on real projects. Internal hackathons and small real use cases teach more than courses alone.
Knowledge of company systems, data and processes is often harder to acquire than AI engineering skills, which is why internal engineers are so valuable.

cards.title: Les experts métier sont essentiels
cards.text: Comptables, négociants, juristes et ingénieurs définissent ce qu'est un « bon » résultat, étiquettent des exemples et valident les sorties. Sans eux, les solutions d'IA passent à côté de l'essentiel.

deep.x: Domain experts know what a correct, useful answer looks like. Without them, AI solutions can be technically impressive and practically useless.
Examples

items.b: which mismatches matter and which don't
which contract clauses carry real risk

deep.x: Building eval sets
Domain experts create the evaluation sets that decide whether a solution is good enough. Their time is the scarcest resource in many AI projects.
Allocate real time

items.r: 20% of an expert's time formally allocated

deep.x: The best AI teams treat domain experts as core team members, not occasional advisers.

cards.title: Nouveaux rôles
cards.text: De nouveaux rôles émergent : product manager IA, ingénieur IA, spécialiste de l'évaluation, responsable de la gouvernance de l'IA et exploitation des agents.

deep.x: AI is creating new jobs and reshaping existing ones. Several roles barely existed a few years ago.
Hybrid roles
Many new roles combine domain knowledge with AI skill: the "AI-enabled accountant" or the analyst who builds their own agents.
Shifting existing roles
Skills that grow in value

x: Judging quality and spotting errors
Problem framing and process design
Communication and relationships
Supervising automated work

deep.x: Job titles in AI change quickly; underlying skills such as clear problem definition and rigorous evaluation remain stable.

cards.title: Parcours de carrière
cards.text: À mesure que les tâches routinières diminuent, les rôles évoluent vers le jugement, la gestion des exceptions, la relation et la supervision de l'IA. Des parcours de carrière clairs réduisent l'anxiété et retiennent les talents.

deep.x: As AI handles routine tasks, roles shift toward judgement, exceptions, relationships and supervising automated work. Clear career paths reduce anxiety and keep talent.
Entry-level challenge
Many junior roles traditionally learned through routine tasks that AI now handles. Companies need new ways to build experience, such as structured rotations, mentoring and simulated cases.
Making paths visible

x: Show how today's roles evolve in two to three years
Offer reskilling into new roles
Recognise AI skills in performance reviews
Create specialist and expert tracks, not only management

deep.x: People embrace change more readily when they can see their own future in it.

cards.title: Apprentissage continu
cards.text: L'IA évolue vite. Intégrez l'apprentissage au travail : communautés de pratique, démonstrations internes, budgets de formation et temps pour expérimenter.

deep.x: AI tools and techniques change every few months. One-off training goes stale fast, so learning has to become part of the job.
Mechanisms

items.b: regular meetups to share use cases
a few hours a month protected

deep.x: Experimentation
Safe sandboxes where staff can try new tools with non-sensitive data encourage discovery without risk.
Keeping it current

x: Refresh prompt libraries and training materials regularly
Review new model releases centrally and share findings
Retire outdated guidance

deep.x: Some companies dedicate regular "AI days" where teams set aside normal work to explore new uses.

quiz.q: Que fait un centre d'excellence en IA ?
options: Il fixe des standards, construit des plateformes partagées et soutient les équipes
quiz.explain: Expertise et gouvernance centrales.

quiz.q: Dans un modèle hub-and-spoke, les « spokes » sont…
options: Des équipes d'IA intégrées dans les unités métier
quiz.explain: Des équipes locales proches des processus.

quiz.q: Pourquoi les experts métier sont-ils essentiels aux projets d'IA ?
options: Ils définissent ce qu'est un bon résultat et valident les sorties
quiz.explain: La connaissance métier est la clé.

lessons.title: L'IA en finance et en back-office
lessons.summary: Factures, rapprochements et clôture.

cards.title: Traitement des factures
cards.text: L'IA extrait le fournisseur, les dates, les montants, la TVA et les lignes de factures de toute mise en page, les rapproche des bons de commande et des réceptions de marchandises, et signale les écarts.

deep.x: Accounts payable is one of the most proven areas for AI. Modern systems read invoices in any layout, extract the data and match it to orders, leaving people to handle exceptions.
Fields extracted
Old vs new
E-invoicing changes the picture

Structured e-invoices are spreading across Europe. Portugal requires certified invoicing software and unique document codes (ATCUD), and EU rules (ViDA) will make e-invoicing mandatory for many cross-border transactions from 2030. Structured data reduces the need for extraction, but AI remains useful for validation and exceptions.
Aim for "touchless" processing of routine invoices and fast, well-informed handling of the rest.

cards.title: Rapprochement à trois voies
cards.text: Contrôle classique des comptes fournisseurs : la facture, le bon de commande et la réception des marchandises doivent concorder sur les quantités et les prix. L'IA accélère le rapprochement et explique les écarts.

deep.x: The three-way match is a core accounts payable control: before paying, check that the invoice, purchase order and goods receipt agree.

items: Purchase order: what was ordered, at what price

deep.x: Typical mismatches
Tolerances
Small differences within agreed tolerances (for example ±2% or a few euros) pass automatically. Larger ones go to a buyer or AP clerk.
Where AI helps

x: Matching when PO numbers are missing or wrong, using supplier, items and amounts
Handling partial deliveries split across invoices
Explaining mismatches in plain language: "price is 3% above PO; contract allows annual indexation in January"

deep.x: A two-way match (invoice versus PO only) is common for services, where there's no physical goods receipt.

cards.title: Rapprochements
cards.text: Rapprocher relevés bancaires, soldes intragroupe et grands livres est répétitif. Le ML peut apparier des transactions aux références approximatives et apprendre des rapprochements manuels passés.

deep.x: Reconciliation means checking that two records of the same thing agree: bank statements against the ledger, or one company's intercompany balance against another's.
Why it's hard
Machine learning helps
ML learns from past manual matches: which reference patterns go together, typical fee deductions, which customer pays several invoices in one transfer. Match rates rise over time.
Intercompany
Large groups have thousands of intercompany transactions. Mismatches delay consolidation at month-end, so automated matching and dispute workflows save days.
Reconcile continuously, not just at month-end.

cards.title: Clôture financière

items: Suivi de la liste de clôture

cards.text: L'IA peut rédiger des explications d'écarts, vérifier les écritures comptables à la recherche d'anomalies et résumer l'avancement de la clôture, ce qui raccourcit la clôture mensuelle.

deep.x: The month-end close is the process of finalising the books for a period. It's deadline-driven and full of repetitive checks, a strong fit for AI assistance.
Where AI helps
Variance explanations

AI can compare actuals with budget and prior periods, look up underlying transactions and draft explanations: "freight costs +18% due to higher Brazil–Rotterdam rates in March". Controllers review and refine.
Journal entry checks

x: Unusual amounts or accounts
Entries posted at odd times or by unusual users
Round numbers or just below approval limits
Manual entries to rarely used accounts

deep.x: Faster close is valuable mainly because it frees finance time for analysis and gives management earlier information.

cards.title: Prévision de trésorerie

steps: Le modèle prédit les dates de paiement

cards.text: Des modèles de ML prévoient les paiements clients et les sorties fournisseurs à partir de l'historique, ce qui améliore la planification de la trésorerie et du fonds de roulement.

deep.x: Cash forecasting predicts money coming in and going out over days, weeks and months. Better forecasts mean less idle cash, less borrowing and fewer surprises.
Inflows
ML learns how each customer actually pays: some always pay 10 days late, some pay early at quarter-end. That's more accurate than assuming everyone pays on the due date.
Outflows
Why it matters in commodities
Commodity traders face large, volatile cash needs: margin calls on futures, letters of credit and big cargo payments. Accurate forecasts reduce costly emergency funding.
Forecast ranges, not single numbers: treasury needs to know the plausible worst case.

cards.title: Fraude et anomalies
cards.text: Détectez les factures en double, les paiements inhabituels, les coordonnées bancaires modifiées et les fournisseurs suspects avant que l'argent ne parte.

deep.x: Finance AI can catch fraud and errors before money leaves the company: duplicate invoices, changed bank details, unusual payments and fake vendors.
Business email compromise
Fraudsters impersonate suppliers or executives by email, often asking to update bank details or make urgent payments. The FBI reports losses of billions of dollars a year from this type of fraud.
Duplicate invoices
Duplicates often differ slightly: an extra space in the number, a different date format, a scanned copy plus an email copy. Fuzzy matching catches them.
Combining rules and ML

x: Rules catch known risks reliably
Anomaly detection finds new patterns
Humans investigate flagged cases

deep.x: Generative AI makes phishing emails and even voice deepfakes more convincing, which raises the importance of verification by a separate channel.

cards.title: Audits de notes de frais
cards.text: L'IA lit les justificatifs, les compare à la politique et signale les exceptions, pour que les auditeurs examinent les quelques cas à risque au lieu d'échantillonner au hasard.

deep.x: AI reads every expense receipt, checks it against policy and flags the risky few, instead of auditors sampling a small random share.
What it checks
Example flags

x: Hotel claimed on a day when the employee was on leave
Same receipt submitted twice by different colleagues
Alcohol claimed under "meals" above policy limits
Expenses on weekends without travel

deep.x: Benefits
Most employees get faster reimbursement because clean claims pass automatically. Auditors focus on real issues.
Check everything automatically; investigate selectively.

cards.title: Contrôles et auditabilité
cards.text: La finance exige une traçabilité complète : chaque écriture proposée par l'IA doit indiquer les documents sources, le niveau de confiance et qui l'a approuvée. Les auditeurs doivent pouvoir suivre la piste.

deep.x: Finance runs on controls and evidence. Any AI involved in postings or payments must leave a trail auditors can follow.
What must be recorded
Segregation of duties
AI shouldn't break the principle that no single person (or system) both creates and approves a payment. Approval workflows still apply.
Auditor expectations
SOX and similar
Companies subject to the US Sarbanes-Oxley Act or similar internal control regimes must document and test controls involving AI just like any other.

deep.r: good AI processes can make audits easier, with complete logs instead of scattered emails

cards.title: Intégration à l'ERP
cards.text: La valeur apparaît lorsque l'IA est connectée à l'ERP (SAP S/4HANA, Oracle, Dynamics) : lecture des données de référence, proposition d'écritures, mise à jour des flux de travail.

deep.x: Value comes when AI is connected to the ERP, the core system of record for finance, procurement and operations, rather than working on exported spreadsheets.
Major ERPs
Integration approaches

items.b: built-in copilots from the ERP vendor
integration platforms between AI and ERP

deep.x: SAP migrations
Many companies are moving from SAP ECC to S/4HANA ahead of mainstream maintenance ending in 2027. These migrations are a chance to design AI into processes from the start.

x: Clean master data first: AI relies on it
Use standard APIs rather than direct database writes

deep.x: AI that can't write back to the ERP leaves people retyping its results.

cards.title: Mesurer l'IA en finance
cards.text: Suivez le taux de traitement sans intervention, le délai de traitement, le taux d'erreur, le coût par facture, le nombre de jours de clôture et les escomptes de paiement anticipé obtenus.

deep.x: Finance AI is measurable, which makes it a good place to build a credible AI track record.
Example before and after
Key metrics
Value beyond cost

x: Fewer late payment penalties and better supplier relationships
Earlier visibility of liabilities
Better fraud prevention
Finance staff time moved to analysis

deep.x: Report value in finance's own language: cost per transaction, days, euros and control quality.

quiz.q: Qu'est-ce qu'un rapprochement à trois voies (three-way match) ?
options: Rapprocher le bon de commande, la réception des marchandises et la facture
quiz.explain: Un contrôle classique des comptes fournisseurs.

quiz.q: Pourquoi l'IA en finance doit-elle conserver une piste d'audit ?
options: Pour que les auditeurs puissent remonter chaque écriture jusqu'aux sources et aux approbations
quiz.explain: La traçabilité est essentielle.

quiz.q: Que mesure le « taux sans intervention » (touchless rate) ?
options: La part des éléments traités sans intervention humaine
quiz.explain: Un indicateur clé d'automatisation.

lessons.title: L'IA dans les opérations et les matières premières
lessons.summary: Prévision, logistique et appui au négoce.

cards.title: Prévision de la demande
cards.text: Le ML prévoit la demande à partir de l'historique, de la saisonnalité, des prix, de la météo et des événements, ce qui améliore les simples moyennes et aide à planifier la production et les stocks.

deep.x: Demand forecasting predicts how much customers will buy. Machine learning can combine many signals and typically beats simple averages, especially for products with complex patterns.
Typical improvement
Why it matters
Better forecasts mean less stock tied up, fewer stockouts, less waste of perishable goods and smoother production.
Hierarchy
Forecasts are needed at many levels: total, region, product, store. Good systems keep them consistent from the top down.
Forecasts are always wrong; the goal is to be less wrong, and to know how uncertain the forecast is.

cards.title: Visibilité de la chaîne d'approvisionnement
cards.text: L'IA combine les données de l'ERP, des transporteurs, des ports et des fournisseurs pour prédire les retards et suggérer des actions, comme un réacheminement ou une repriorisation des commandes.

deep.x: Supply chain visibility means knowing where goods are and when they'll arrive. AI combines many data sources to predict delays and suggest responses before problems hit.
Data sources
Predictive alerts

items: learn about delay on arrival day

deep.x: Typical actions

x: Reroute shipments or switch ports
Reprioritise customer orders
Expedite alternatives
Inform customers proactively

deep.x: Visibility is valuable only when it leads to earlier, better decisions.

cards.title: Optimisation logistique
cards.text: L'optimisation et le ML planifient les itinéraires, les calendriers de navires, la préparation en entrepôt et le chargement des camions, ce qui réduit les coûts et les émissions.

deep.x: Optimisation algorithms and machine learning plan routes, schedules and loads, cutting cost, time and emissions across logistics networks.
Optimisation plus ML
Example
A route optimiser for a delivery fleet considers time windows, vehicle capacity, driver hours and traffic, problems far too large to solve well by hand.
Benefits

x: Fewer kilometres and less fuel
Better vehicle and vessel utilisation
More reliable delivery times

deep.x: UPS's ORION route optimisation system is reported to save about 100 million miles a year.

cards.title: Maintenance prédictive
cards.text: Des capteurs sur les machines (vibrations, température, puissance) alimentent des modèles qui prédisent les pannes, de sorte que la maintenance a lieu avant la casse.

deep.x: Predictive maintenance uses sensor data to forecast equipment failures, so repairs happen just before they're needed rather than too early or too late.
Maintenance strategies

items: Predictive: fix before failure based on condition
Preventive: fix on a fixed schedule

deep.x: Typical signals
Benefits

Industry estimates commonly cite meaningful reductions in unplanned downtime and maintenance costs, particularly for critical equipment like conveyors, crushers, pumps and compressors in plants and ports.
Requirements

x: Sensors and connectivity on key equipment
History of failures to learn from
Maintenance teams that trust and act on alerts

deep.x: Start with the few machines whose failure stops everything.

cards.title: Signaux de prix des matières premières
cards.text: Les modèles combinent données d'offre et de demande, météo, état des cultures, fret et indicateurs macroéconomiques pour étayer les analyses. Ils éclairent le jugement des négociants, sans le remplacer.

deep.x: Price models in commodities combine fundamental data, weather, freight and macro indicators. They support analysts and traders; they don't replace judgement.
Fundamentals
Where AI helps

x: Processing far more data sources than an analyst can read
Summarising reports, news and policy announcements in many languages
Detecting patterns in positioning and flows
Scenario analysis

deep.x: Limits

deep.w: An AI model can reliably predict commodity prices
deep.r: markets react to new information quickly; models provide an edge in analysis, not certainty

cards.title: Données satellitaires et météo
cards.text: Les images satellite et les prévisions météo aident à estimer la santé des cultures et les rendements dans des régions comme le Brésil, le Midwest américain et la mer Noire avant les rapports officiels.

deep.x: Satellite imagery and weather forecasts help estimate crop conditions and yields across major producing regions, often before official reports.
Key regions
Free and commercial data
The EU's Copernicus Sentinel-2 satellites provide free imagery at 10 m resolution, revisiting each spot every few days. Commercial providers offer higher resolution and daily coverage.
What's measured
Official reports
The USDA's monthly WASDE report is a key market event. Satellite-based estimates help analysts anticipate it.
Clouds are a major obstacle for optical satellites; radar satellites like Sentinel-1 can see through clouds.

cards.title: Intelligence des contrats
cards.text: L'IA générative extrait les termes clés des contrats de négoce (quantités, spécifications de qualité, périodes d'expédition, Incoterms, surestaries, conditions de paiement) et signale les clauses inhabituelles.

deep.x: Trade contracts contain many terms that affect cost and risk. Generative AI extracts them into structured data and flags unusual clauses for review.
Incoterms
The International Chamber of Commerce's Incoterms (current version 2020) define who pays for transport, insurance and risk at each stage. FOB and CIF are common in bulk commodities.
Flagging deviations
Benefits

x: Faster contract review and fewer missed obligations
A searchable database of all terms across thousands of contracts
Earlier detection of risky terms

deep.x: Structured contract data turns documents into something you can analyse.

cards.title: Opérations de négoce
cards.text: L'IA aide pour les documents (connaissements, certificats, lettres de crédit), en vérifiant leur cohérence et en repérant les écarts avant qu'ils ne retardent les paiements.

deep.x: Commodity trade involves many documents that must agree exactly. Discrepancies delay payments and cargo, so AI checks consistency before submission.
Letters of credit

A letter of credit is a bank's promise to pay when documents match the credit's terms exactly. Banks check documents under international rules (UCP 600), and a large share of first presentations are rejected for discrepancies.
Typical discrepancies
Digital trade documents
Electronic bills of lading are gaining legal recognition, for example under the UK's Electronic Trade Documents Act 2023, reducing paper and fraud risk.
A single discrepancy in a letter of credit, such as a misspelled port name, can delay payment of millions of euros.

cards.title: Risques et conformité
cards.text: Le filtrage des sanctions, le risque de contrepartie et le suivi des navires bénéficient d'une IA qui surveille l'actualité, les données de propriété et les mouvements de navires.

deep.x: Trading firms must screen counterparties, vessels and transactions for sanctions and other risks. AI helps monitor large, fast-changing data.
Vessel tracking
Ships broadcast their positions through AIS. Gaps in signals ("going dark"), unusual ship-to-ship transfers and route anomalies can indicate sanctions evasion.
Adverse media
Beneficial ownership
Sanctioned parties often hide behind layers of companies. Graph analytics trace ownership chains across registries.
AI can screen everything; compliance experts decide.

cards.title: Des humains dans la boucle
cards.text: Dans le négoce et les opérations, l'IA fournit des signaux et de l'automatisation, tandis que des personnes expérimentées prennent les décisions commerciales et de risque.

deep.x: In trading and operations, AI provides signals, analysis and automation, while experienced people make commercial and risk decisions.
Why humans stay in charge

x: Markets change in ways history doesn't predict
Relationships and negotiation drive commercial outcomes
Accountability for large risk decisions must sit with people
Regulation and internal controls require it

deep.x: Augmentation
Designing the split
Algorithmic trading is common in financial markets, but physical commodity trading still relies heavily on human judgement because of logistics, quality and relationships.

quiz.q: Sur quoi s'appuie la maintenance prédictive ?
options: Des données de capteurs pour prédire les pannes
quiz.explain: Réparer avant la panne.

quiz.q: Dans les contrats de négoce, qu'est-ce que la surestarie (demurrage) ?
options: Une charge par jour lorsqu'un navire est retardé au-delà des staries convenues
quiz.explain: Généralement un tarif journalier.

quiz.q: Qui doit prendre les décisions finales de négoce ?
options: Des personnes expérimentées, aidées par les signaux de l'IA
quiz.explain: L'IA éclaire ; les personnes décident.

lessons.title: L'IA dans le service client et la vente
lessons.summary: Des réponses plus rapides et une meilleure vente.

cards.title: Copilotes de support

steps: L'IA rédige une réponse avec ses sources

cards.text: L'IA rédige des réponses pour les agents à partir de bases de connaissances et de l'historique des dossiers. Les agents modifient et envoient, et traitent plus de dossiers avec une qualité constante.

deep.x: A support copilot works alongside human agents: it reads the customer's message and history, searches the knowledge base and drafts a reply that the agent edits and sends.

steps: Copilot reads history and knowledge base

deep.x: Evidence

A large 2023 study of over 5,000 customer support agents (Brynjolfsson, Li and Raymond) found an AI assistant increased issues resolved per hour by about 14% on average, and by around 34% for the least experienced agents.
The most experienced agents saw little measurable change: the assistant mainly spread their know-how to others.
What copilots do
Why start here

x: Humans still review every reply, so risk is low
Gains are measurable: handling time, resolution rate
Agents' edits become training and evaluation data

deep.x: Copilots spread the knowledge of your best agents to everyone.

cards.title: Assistants en libre-service

steps: Cas complexe : passer à un humain

cards.text: Les assistants en contact avec les clients répondent aux questions courantes 24 h/24, 7 j/7 et passent la main à des humains pour les cas complexes ou sensibles, avec tout le contexte transmis.

deep.x: Customer-facing assistants answer common questions around the clock, take simple actions and hand over to humans when needed, passing on the full context.

steps: Complex or upset? Hand over with summary

deep.x: What works well
A high-profile example

In 2024, Klarna reported its AI assistant handled two-thirds of its customer service chats in its first month, equivalent to about 700 full-time agents. In 2025 the company emphasised that customers must always be able to reach a human, after concerns about service quality.
Good handover
Guardrails

x: Answer only from approved knowledge, with sources
Never invent policies, prices or promises
Recognise frustration and escalate early

deep.x: Customers often prefer self-service for simple tasks, but strongly dislike being trapped with a bot when their problem is complex.

cards.title: Tri des tickets
cards.text: Classez les demandes entrantes par sujet, urgence et langue, et acheminez-les automatiquement vers la bonne équipe.

deep.x: Triage classifies incoming requests by topic, urgency, language and customer value, then routes them to the right team, often in seconds rather than hours.
Before and after
Extra value

x: Extract order numbers and account details automatically
Detect duplicates and link related tickets
Spot emerging issues: a spike in "app won't open" tickets signals an outage

deep.x: Triage is a quiet, high-volume win: small time savings on every single ticket.

cards.title: Sentiment et qualité
cards.text: L'IA analyse les conversations pour en tirer le sentiment, les problèmes récurrents et la conformité, offrant aux managers une vision de toutes les interactions, et pas seulement d'échantillons.

deep.x: AI can analyse every customer conversation, not just a small sample, revealing sentiment trends, recurring problems and compliance issues.
From sampling to full coverage
Insights for the business
Contact reasons reveal broken processes elsewhere: confusing invoices, late deliveries, unclear product instructions. Fixing the cause reduces contacts entirely.
Caution

x: Use it for coaching and insight, not covert surveillance of employees
Inform staff and involve employee representatives where required
Emotion recognition systems are banned in EU workplaces under the AI Act; analysing text for topic and customer satisfaction is different, but check with legal

deep.x: The best contact is the one that never needed to happen.

cards.title: Assistants commerciaux
cards.text: L'IA prépare des fiches de compte, résume les réunions, rédige des propositions et met à jour le CRM, ce qui donne plus de temps aux commerciaux avec leurs clients.

deep.x: AI sales assistants handle preparation and admin, giving salespeople more time with customers.
Before a meeting
The assistant gathers recent orders, open issues, news about the customer and notes from past meetings into a one-page briefing.
After a meeting
Where time goes
Keeping it human
Customers value genuine relationships. AI should free time for real conversations, not flood customers with generic automated emails.
CRM data quality often improves with AI because updates happen automatically instead of relying on busy salespeople to type them.

cards.title: Scoring des prospects

viz.unit: conversion en % par tranche de score (illustratif)

cards.text: Le ML note les prospects selon leur probabilité d'achat, d'après les ventes passées, le comportement et les données firmographiques, pour que les commerciaux se concentrent sur les plus prometteurs.

deep.x: Lead scoring uses machine learning to estimate how likely each prospect is to buy, so sales teams spend time on the most promising leads.
Inputs
Making scores useful

x: Explain the main reasons for each score, so salespeople trust it
Retrain as markets and products change
Compare outcomes against salespeople's own judgement

deep.x: Pitfalls

items.b: low-scored leads never get called, so they never convert
past focus on certain regions repeats

deep.x: Use scores to prioritise, and keep testing some low-scored leads to check the model is right.

cards.title: Aide à la tarification

steps: Le modèle suggère une fourchette de prix

cards.text: Des modèles suggèrent des prix ou des remises d'après l'historique des affaires, la demande et la concurrence, dans les limites fixées par l'entreprise.

deep.x: AI pricing tools suggest prices or discounts based on deal history, demand, costs and competition, while the business sets the guardrails.
Inputs
Guardrails

x: Minimum margins and maximum discounts
Approval needed outside the range
Rules against discriminatory pricing
Competition law limits: no sharing or aligning prices with competitors

deep.x: Dynamic pricing
Competition law

Using shared pricing algorithms or competitor data platforms can raise antitrust concerns if they facilitate collusion. Regulators in the US and EU have scrutinised algorithmic pricing in sectors like rental housing.
Even small price improvements matter: in thin-margin businesses, a 1% better price can raise profit by far more than 1%.

cards.title: Personnalisation
cards.text: Recommander des produits et contenus pertinents augmente la conversion, mais doit respecter la vie privée et ne pas être intrusif.

deep.x: Personalisation tailors products, content and offers to each customer. Done well, it raises conversion and satisfaction; done badly, it feels creepy or unfair.
How recommendations work
Privacy rules

x: GDPR requires a legal basis for profiling and transparency about it
Cookie and tracking consent rules apply to web behaviour
Avoid inferring sensitive data such as health or religion
Let customers see and adjust their preferences

deep.x: Business impact
Personalise to help customers, not just to sell more to them.

cards.title: Être transparent
cards.text: Les clients doivent savoir quand ils parlent à une IA et pouvoir toujours joindre un humain. L'AI Act de l'UE impose d'en informer l'utilisateur pour les chatbots.

deep.x: Customers should know when they're dealing with AI and always have a path to a human. It's both a legal requirement and a trust builder.
EU AI Act

Providers must design AI systems that interact with people so that users are informed they're dealing with AI, unless it's obvious from context. Deepfakes and certain AI-generated content must be labelled. These transparency obligations apply from August 2026.
Good disclosure

items.w: Hidden bot with a human name

cards.title: Assistants de politiques internes
cards.text: Les employés posent des questions sur les politiques RH, les règles de déplacement ou les procédures informatiques et obtiennent des réponses fondées sur les documents officiels, avec des liens.

deep.x: Policy assistants answer employees' questions about HR policies, travel rules, IT procedures or expense limits, grounded in official documents with links.
Common questions
Requirements

x: Only approved, current documents in the knowledge base
Country-specific answers, since policies differ by location
Citations so employees can check the source
Escalation to HR for personal or sensitive cases

cards.title: Recrutement : prudence
cards.text: Le tri des CV et le classement des candidats sont à haut risque selon l'AI Act de l'UE. Utilisez l'IA en appui (rédaction d'offres, planification, résumés) et laissez les décisions à des humains, avec des tests de biais.

deep.x: AI in recruiting is high-risk. CV screening and candidate ranking can discriminate, and the EU AI Act classifies them as high-risk systems.
EU AI Act

AI systems used to recruit or select people, filter applications or evaluate candidates are listed as high-risk. Deployers must ensure human oversight, monitor the system, keep logs and inform candidates and workers.
Lessons from failures
An experimental Amazon CV-screening tool, reported in 2018, learned to downgrade CVs containing the word "women's" because it was trained on a decade of mostly male hires. Amazon abandoned it.
Safer practices

x: Use AI to assist recruiters, not to reject candidates automatically
Test outcomes by gender, age and other groups
Tell candidates when AI is used
Offer human review of decisions

cards.title: Intégration des nouveaux
cards.text: Des assistants d'IA guident les nouveaux employés dans les systèmes, les politiques et les premières tâches, et répondent à leurs questions à tout moment.

x: Knows the role, location and team of the new hire
Gives a personalised checklist for the first weeks
Answers practical questions: "how do I book a meeting room?"
Escalates to the manager or HR for anything personal

deep.x: Benefits
Human connection
Let AI handle the practical questions so people can focus on relationships.

cards.title: Formation et développement
cards.text: L'IA crée du contenu pédagogique, des quiz et des parcours personnalisés, et joue le rôle de tuteur, comme cette appli.

Personalisation
Role-play
AI can simulate difficult conversations: a negotiation, a customer complaint, a performance review. Learners practise safely and get feedback.
Evidence on learning

x: Spaced repetition and retrieval practice (quizzes) strongly improve memory
Short, frequent sessions beat long, rare ones
Active practice beats passive reading

deep.x: Apps like this one use these principles: short cards, quizzes and repetition over time.

cards.title: Confidentialité des données des employés

items: Pas de reconnaissance des émotions au travail

cards.text: Les données RH sont sensibles. Restreignez l'accès, minimisez les données, évitez la reconnaissance des émotions au travail (interdite par l'AI Act de l'UE) et associez les représentants du personnel lorsque c'est requis.

Banned and high-risk

AI deciding promotions, terminations, task allocation, monitoring
employee consent rarely valid due to power imbalance

cards.title: Veille de conformité
cards.text: L'IA suit les évolutions réglementaires, les rattache aux politiques internes et signale les lacunes, ce qui aide les équipes de conformité à suivre le rythme.

deep.x: Regulations change constantly. AI helps compliance teams track changes, map them to internal policies and flag gaps.
Sources
Typical uses

x: Horizon scanning: what's coming next year?
Mapping obligations to controls and owners
Answering questions about internal policies
Checking documents and communications for compliance issues

deep.x: Human expertise

cards.title: Les juristes restent responsables

Professional duties
Confidentiality

Good practice

Expert sign-off on all AI-assisted work
Record AI use where relevant
Train lawyers on limits, especially hallucinated citations

deep.x: AI is a powerful junior colleague: fast, tireless and in need of supervision.
